answer: Each identity may endorse only 5 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 530 aliases need 530 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. A gale of doubt is healthy, a basalt of proof is required, and a vault of patience is the price of a clean panel.
